shortDescription: Manages GAD pairs on VSP block storage systems.

options.name: connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the storage system.

options.name: secondary_connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the secondary storage system.

options.name: spec
options.description: Specification for the GAD pairs task.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired lifecycle management state of the GAD pairs task. Use C(present) to create a standard GAD pair configuration. Use C(forced_present) to force creation when resource is locked by hv_resource_group_lock module. Use C(absent) to delete the GAD pair. Use C(split), C(resync), C(swap_split), C(swap_resync), or C(expand) to manage active pair operations.

options.name: storage_system_info
options.description: Information about the storage system. This field is an optional field.
